Travel Notice for Companion Animal Flights

Travelers need to check animal rules before booking with Aurelia Skyways.

A reptile must be at least 11 weeks old before travel. This age limit protects the animal and supports safe handling at the terminal and on board.

A cat crate must have a longest side of 61 cm. Use a sturdy crate with secure locks, clean bedding, and enough room for the animal to stand and turn without strain.

Please keep documents, feeding items, and contact details ready before departure. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, and our staff will help you prepare each step in order.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel.  

Communications Aide, Companion Animal Travel Desk
